lessons.subject: English
lessons.title: Phonics: sh, ch and th
lessons.summary: Read 3 sounds that are each made by 2 letters.
lessons.curriculum: Year 1 English, reading: the right sound for each grapheme, including digraphs such as sh, ch and th
pages: Sometimes 2 letters make one sound. We call this a digraph.
The letters s and h make ‘sh’, as in ship. The letters c and h make ‘ch’, as in chip.
The letters t and h make ‘th’, as in thin. Say each word slowly: sh-i-p, ch-i-p, th-i-n.

check.question: Which word starts with the ‘sh’ sound?
check.explanation: Ship starts with s and h, which make the ‘sh’ sound.

lessons.subject: Maths
lessons.title: Number bonds to 10
lessons.summary: Find pairs of numbers that add up to 10.
lessons.curriculum: Year 1 maths: represent and use number bonds and related subtraction facts within 20
pages: A number bond is a pair of numbers that add up to a total.
These pairs add up to 10. 1 and 9. 2 and 8. 3 and 7. 4 and 6. 5 and 5.
If you know 3 + 7 = 10, you also know 10 − 3 = 7.

lessons.subject: Science
lessons.title: Animal groups
lessons.summary: Sort animals into 5 groups by what they are like.
lessons.curriculum: Year 1 science: identify and name common fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds and mammals
pages: Scientists sort animals into groups. Here are 5 groups: fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds and mammals.
Fish live in water and breathe with gills. Frogs are amphibians. They live in water and on land.
Reptiles, like snakes, have dry, scaly skin. Birds have feathers. Mammals have hair or fur and feed their babies milk.

check.question: A robin has feathers and lays eggs. Which group is it in?

lessons.subject: Geography
lessons.title: Countries and capitals of the UK
lessons.summary: Name the 4 countries of the UK and their capital cities.
lessons.curriculum: Key stage 1 geography: name, locate and identify characteristics of the 4 countries and capital cities of the UK
pages: The UK is made up of 4 countries: England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.
Each country has a capital city. London is the capital of England, and of the whole UK.
Edinburgh is the capital of Scotland. Cardiff is the capital of Wales. Belfast is the capital of Northern Ireland.

check.question: What is the capital city of Wales?
check.explanation: Cardiff is the capital city of Wales.
